description: Iron condor figures from the four strikes and the net credit: both wing widths, maximum profit and loss, both breakevens, return on risk, credit-to-width, and the model's chance of profit when implied volatility and days are given. A side the credit covers in full has no breakeven, and the answer says so.

credit.description: Total net credit received per share for the four legs, in dollars.
credit.title: Credit

days.description: Days to expiration, for the chance of profit. Optional.
days.title: Days

iv_pct.description: Implied volatility, percent per year, for the chance of profit. Optional.
iv_pct.title: Iv Pct

long_call_strike.description: The strike of the call bought, the highest of the four, in dollars.
long_call_strike.title: Long Call Strike

long_put_strike.description: The strike of the put bought, the lowest of the four, in dollars.
long_put_strike.title: Long Put Strike

short_call_strike.description: The strike of the call sold, in dollars.
short_call_strike.title: Short Call Strike

short_put_strike.description: The strike of the put sold, in dollars.
short_put_strike.title: Short Put Strike
